About the Lindener Ratsstuben: Tradition Meets international Flair

For many years, we have been a permanent institution in Linden and a popular meeting place for young and old alike. Our concept of running an authentic international restaurant stems from our own family history and a deep love for both culinary cultures. We firmly believe that good food brings people together, and this is exactly what we want to prove every day in our cozy premises. Get to know us and learn more about the philosophy that makes our house so special and unique in the local gastronomic landscape.

Our Philosophy: Freshness, Quality, and Regional Connection

In the kitchen of the Lindener Ratsstuben, we attach great importance to freshness and the highest quality of all ingredients used. Whenever possible, we source our products from regional suppliers from the area around Linden. This not only guarantees short transport routes and absolute freshness but also supports local agriculture. Our chefs prepare each dish fresh for you with great care and craftsmanship. We deliberately avoid artificial flavor enhancers and instead rely on fresh herbs and authentic spices. Whether in the preparation of our classic international meat dishes or the original international pasta – you can taste our love for detail in every single bite.

This personal touch makes our restaurant in Linden a place where you immediately feel at home. We are proud of our motivated team in the service and in the kitchen, who take care of your physical well-being every day with a smile. Your satisfaction is our most beautiful reward.

The Team of the Lindener Ratsstuben Looks Forward to Seeing You

We at the Lindener Ratsstuben see ourselves not only as service providers but as passionate hosts. Our goal is that you leave our international restaurant in Linden with a smile and gladly return. Behind the scenes, our dedicated team works daily to develop new culinary ideas and bring our proven classics to the plate in the usual quality. We cordially invite you to become part of our story. Visit us, let yourself be infected by our warm hospitality, and experience for yourself why our house and our in-house bowling alley have been a permanent fixture in the region for so many years. We look forward to your visit and to providing you with unforgettable moments!

Sustainability and Responsibility for the Future

In this day and age, it is particularly important to us not only to serve excellent international dishes but also to take responsibility for our environment. In the Lindener Ratsstuben, we therefore increasingly rely on sustainable concepts, whether in reducing food waste, using environmentally friendly packaging for our takeaway service, or the conscious use of energy. We believe that a good restaurant in Linden should also make a positive contribution to the community. By supporting local producers and conserving resources, we want to ensure that future generations can also enjoy the pleasure of good, honest food. We invite you to walk this path together with us and experience the culinary diversity of our house with a clear conscience.

Explore Our Exquisite international Menu in Linden

Get ready for a culinary adventure! Our carefully curated menu perfectly showcases the beautiful harmony between two of Europe’s most celebrated cuisines. As the premier international restaurant in Linden, we are thrilled to offer a wide and diverse selection of dishes that cater to all tastes, dietary preferences, and cravings. Whether you are in the mood for a light Mediterranean starter, a hearty Central European main course, or a decadent dessert to satisfy your sweet tooth, our chefs have prepared something truly extraordinary just for you. We take immense pride in cooking everything fresh to order, ensuring that you receive the highest quality of flavors on your plate. Browse our offerings and prepare to indulge your senses in an unforgettable dining experience.

Authentic international Classics and Mediterranean Flavors

Let us start with the sunny flavors of the South. Our international selection features everything you would expect from a top-tier authentic Trattoria. Enjoy our hand-tossed wood-fired pizzas, crafted with a slowly fermented dough that provides the perfect crispy crust, topped with rich San Marzano tomato sauce and creamy mozzarella. Dive into our extensive list of fresh handmade pastas, including classic Carbonara with crispy pancetta, rich Bolognese simmered for hours, and delicate seafood linguine. We use only the finest olive oils, fresh basil, and aged Parmesan to ensure every single international dish sings with flavor. Vegetarian and vegan options are plentiful across our menu, guaranteeing that everyone can enjoy a vibrant, mouth-watering slice of Italy right here in Linden.

Traditional international Favorites and Hearty Home Cooking

For those craving something robust and comforting, our international specialties will definitely not disappoint. We proudly serve what many consider the best authentic international Schnitzel in Linden, pan-fried to a perfect golden brown and accompanied by crispy roasted potatoes and fresh, seasonal side salads. Our hearty roasts, savory local sausages, and traditional side dishes like homemade red cabbage and Spätzle are prepared following generations-old family recipes. Every bite evokes the warmth and comfort of a classic international Gasthaus, making our Linden restaurant the perfect spot for a satisfying, soul-warming meal after a long day of work or exploring the beautiful surroundings of our town.

To perfectly complement your dining experience, we offer an extensive and thoughtfully curated beverage menu. Choose from a fantastic selection of crisp, refreshing international beers on tap, carefully selected international and local regional wines that pair wonderfully with our dishes, and a variety of refreshing non-alcoholic options, juices, and sodas. Our knowledgeable staff is always on hand to recommend the perfect wine or beer pairing for your chosen meal, elevating the flavors and ensuring a harmonious culinary journey. Whether you prefer a full-bodied international red with your pasta or a cold international Pilsner with your Schnitzel, we have you covered.

Delicious Desserts and Unforgettable Experiences

Do not forget to save room for dessert! From classic international Tiramisu, soaked in rich espresso, to warm international Apfelstrudel served with velvety vanilla sauce, our homemade sweets are the absolute perfect way to conclude your feast. Browse our complete menu online, discover your new favorite dish, and remember to book our in-house bowling alley (Kegelbahn) to add some active fun to your evening. Combining exceptional international food with a friendly atmosphere and exciting entertainment options makes our venue the ultimate destination for dining and leisure. Privacy Policy: Protecting Your Data in Linden

Your absolute privacy and the robust security of your personal data are of the utmost importance to us at our international restaurant in Linden. We want you to feel completely safe, secure, and comfortable when you visit our website, book a table for dinner, or reserve our popular in-house bowling alley (Kegelbahn). This comprehensive Privacy Policy (Datenschutzerklärung) is carefully designed to inform you transparently and thoroughly about exactly how we collect, process, use, and protect your personal information in strict accordance with the European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and all other applicable national data protection laws. We always treat your personal data with the highest level of respect, care, and confidentiality.

Data Collection When Visiting Our Website

When you interact with our website, certain technical data is inevitably and automatically collected to ensure the smooth operation of our online presence. This standard technical data includes, for example, your IP address, your browser type and version, your operating system, the time of your server request, and the specific pages you view. This information is primarily used for statistical analysis, system security, and to continually optimize the way we showcase our authentic international menu to our online visitors. This automated data collection is generally anonymized and cannot be directly traced back to you as a specific individual without further information.

Processing of Voluntarily Provided Information

In addition to automated technical data, we process information that you actively and voluntarily provide to us. This happens, for example, when you fill out our contact form, subscribe to our newsletter, or use our online table reservation system. In these cases, we may collect your name, phone number, email address, and any specific requests or dietary requirements you mention. We use this voluntarily provided information exclusively to process your specific requests, confirm your reservations for our Linden restaurant, answer your questions, and ensure you have a flawless and personalized dining experience with us. We will never use this data for unauthorized advertising purposes without your explicit consent.

Data Security Measures and Third-Party Sharing

We employ state-of-the-art technical and organizational security measures, including SSL/TLS encryption, to protect your personal data comprehensively against unauthorized access, accidental loss, destruction, or manipulation. You can recognize an encrypted connection by the "https://" prefix and the lock symbol in your browser line. We guarantee that your information is never sold to third parties. It is only shared with trusted, rigorously vetted service providers (such as our web hosting company or the provider of our reservation software) when it is absolutely necessary for our core business operations. These processors are contractually bound to adhere to strict data protection standards.

Your Extensive Data Protection Rights

As a valued guest of our international dining establishment, you possess extensive statutory rights regarding your personal data. You have the right to request comprehensive information about the data we currently hold about you free of charge. You also have the right to demand corrections of inaccurate data, request the complete deletion of your data, or restrict the processing of your personal information at any time, provided this does not conflict with any statutory retention obligations (such as tax or commercial laws). If you wish to exercise your data protection rights or have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact our designated Data Protection Officer using the contact details prominently provided in our Imprint.

Right of Withdrawal for Online Bookings and Services

This page thoroughly outlines the statutory Right of Withdrawal (Widerrufsrecht) that may be applicable to certain specific services provided and sold online by our international restaurant in Linden. We strive to be fully transparent and compliant regarding your consumer rights when you are interacting and transacting with us via the internet. While the traditional, everyday act of walking into a restaurant, sitting at a table, and ordering a meal does not fall under distance selling regulations, certain online transactions may be subject to statutory withdrawal rights under the applicable European and national consumer protection laws.

Your General Right to Cancel Online Contracts

If you explicitly conclude a contract with us via distance communication means (for example, by buying a digital gift voucher online or paying for merchandise via our website), you generally have the legal right to withdraw from this specific contract within a period of fourteen (14) days without needing to provide any reason. The withdrawal period strictly begins on the day the contract is officially concluded. To successfully exercise your right of withdrawal regarding these specific qualifying online purchases, you must inform us of your decision through a clear, unambiguous written statement. You can do this conveniently by sending an email or a formal letter to the contact addresses clearly provided in our Imprint.

Important Exceptions to the Right of Withdrawal

It is absolutely crucial to understand the legal exceptions to this general right of withdrawal. According to prevailing law, the right of withdrawal does not apply to contracts for the provision of services related to leisure activities, accommodation, or catering if the contract provides for a specific, fixed date or period of performance. Therefore, fixed-date reservations for dining tables, specialized catering events, holiday buffets, and time-specific bookings for our in-house bowling alley (Kegelbahn) on a specific date cannot be withdrawn under standard distance selling rules once they are confirmed.

Refund Process and Standard Cancellations

If you successfully, legally, and timely withdraw from a qualifying online purchase (like an entirely unused digital gift card), we are obligated to reimburse all payments received from you promptly, and no later than fourteen days from the day we officially receive your valid withdrawal notice.
